description: Fix add() so it returns the sum of a and b.
Fix sub() so it returns a minus b.
Fix mul() so it returns the product of a and b.
Fix div() so it returns a divided by b.
Fix power() so it returns base raised to exp.
Fix is_even() so it returns True for even numbers.
Fix factorial() so factorial(5) is 120.
Fix average() so it divides by the number of items.
Fix reverse() so it returns the string reversed.
Fix is_palindrome() so it is case-insensitive.
Fix count_vowels() so it counts all five vowels including u.
Fix title_case() so it capitalizes each word.
Fix slugify() so spaces become hyphens.
Fix truncate() so truncate(s, n) returns exactly n chars.
Fix repeat() so repeats are joined with no separator.
Fix get_nested() so it walks nested dicts and returns default only when a key is missing.
Fix merge_dicts() so nested dicts merge recursively instead of being overwritten.
Fix flatten_dict() so nested keys join with dots (already correct shape; keep behavior).
Fix env_int() so it returns an int, not the raw string.
Fix validate_port() so it only accepts integers from 1 to 65535.
